<h2>Validate Trait Review Decisions</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Validates review schema, human approval, candidate coverage, selectors,
and correction-rule conflicts against current trait records.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_trait_review_decisions(
  data_trait_review_decisions,
  data_trait_records,
  data_trait_review_candidates
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_review_decisions">data_trait_review_decisions</code></td>
<td>
<p>Decision data loaded by [load_trait_review_decisions()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_records">data_trait_records</code></td>
<td>
<p>Current trait records for the review stage.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_trait_review_candidates">data_trait_review_candidates</code></td>
<td>
<p>Current candidates from [build_trait_review_candidates()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>A tibble containing validated review decisions.
</p>

</main>
